## About this app

Event Explorer lets you interactively filter and visualize event data. Select
time periods, event types, and data sources to see patterns in real time.

## How to use it

The dashboard accepts URL parameters for deep linking from blog posts. For
example, clicking a link like `?period=Q3` will pre-select the Q3 time period
when the app loads.
